visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male character wearing a blue knitted sweater and a brown bear-themed plush hood sits at a wooden desk. He looks toward the camera with a gentle smile and turns toward a calendar. On the desk, a sheep-shaped lamp with a glowing light sits next to a bundle of dried lavender in a ceramic vase. The background is a textured grey wall with soft, warm lighting. (2) The focus shifts to a close-up of the character's hands as they interact with a large vertical desk calendar. The hands grip the top edge of a white paper page, carefully folding and tearing it along a perforated line. The desk surface holds a small roll of tape and some books, creating a cozy and organized indoor atmosphere. (3) The camera settles on a static shot of the new calendar page displaying a large red number '1' and 'January 1, 2025'. White text overlays appear over the top half of the screen, providing poetic content in Chinese characters. The background elements like the sheep lamp and lavender remain partially visible on the left side of the frame.
